parameters.query:
INSERT INTO subscriptions (
  clinic_id,
  license_id,
  subscription_type,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  max_doctors,
  max_receptionists,
  max_admins,
  max_super_admins,
  max_monthly_new_patients,
  ai_access,
  notes,
  issued_at
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid,
  $2::uuid,
  $3,
  $4::date,
  $5::date,
  $6::int,
  $7::int,
  $8::int,
  $9::int,
  $10::int,
  $11,
  $12,
  $13::timestamptz
)
RETURNING
  id,
  clinic_id,
  license_id,
  subscription_type,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  max_doctors,
  max_receptionists,
  max_admins,
  max_super_admins,
  max_monthly_new_patients,
  ai_access,
  notes,
  issued_at,
  created_at

meta.notes:
CONFIGURACIÓN REQUERIDA:
1. Crear una credencial de tipo 'Postgres' en n8n con los datos de conexión.
2. En el nodo 'Insertar Suscripción', seleccionar esa credencial (reemplaza POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID).
3. Activar el workflow.

RUTA DEL WEBHOOK:
POST https://<tu-n8n>/webhook/subscriptions

AUTENTICACIÓN:
Requiere header: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>
El token se decodifica para extraer el clinic_id (soporta claims: clinic_id, clinicId, clinic)

PAYLOAD:
{
  "licenseId": "uuid-del-payload-descifrado",
  "subscriptionType": "monthly" | "annual" | "custom",
  "startDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endDate": "2026-12-31",
  "maxDoctors": 5,
  "maxReceptionists": 3,
  "maxAdmins": 2,
  "maxSuperAdmins": 1,
  "maxMonthlyNewPatients": 200,
  "aiAccess": "full" | "doctors_only" | "none",
  "notes": "Opcional",
  "issuedAt": "2026-05-29T12:00:00.000Z"
}

RESPUESTA EXITOSA (HTTP 201):
{ "id": "uuid", "clinic_id": "uuid", "license_id": "uuid", ... }

NOTA: Este endpoint se llama automáticamente desde /system/licenses cada vez que se genera una nueva licencia, para registrar el historial de suscripciones.

TABLA REQUERIDA: subscriptions (ver 030_20260529_licensing-tables-and-permissions.sql)
